test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Myoko festival is celebrated in which of the following North-Eastern states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Myoko festival**

 
 
• Myoko is a harvest festival celebrated in the Ziro Valley of Arunachal Pradesh.

 
 
• During this festival, the locals offer prayers to the gods and goddesses for a good harvest.
